headline: US Jobs BOMBED 💣📉 July Drop 23K 😱 Fed STUCK 🧊
text: US jobs market just took an L 😭📉 when analysts expected 80K new GIGS 🎤 but instead got a SURPRISE -23K 😳💀! Summer heat 🔥☀️ got local gov schools 🏫📚 and retail 🛒💸 sweating bullets - warehouse clubs 🏭🔥, gas stations ⛽😩, and hypermarkets 🛍️ all caught the L! May + June got REVISED down 103K 📉🔥, making this a SLOW JAM summer ☀️🐌! Fed Chair Powell 🍦👨‍💼 sitting on rate HIKES all year, now facing a WEAK JOBS market vs STICKY INFLATION 🍞🔥 dilemma! Labor force participation back to COVID levels 😷📉, meaning ZERO new gigs being created 🛑💼! This data gives Fed a FREE PASS to chill on hikes in September 🗓️🧊, no rate hike drama! Birrell says jobs market softer 'by some distance' 📏😤, leaving Powell with the ultimate catch-22 🤡🔄!
